intentPaths.title: Make a character
intentPaths.blurb: Draw a sprite, animate it, then share a character card.

steps.title: Draw your sprite
steps.desc: Pixel Studio. Start with a simple 8x8 or 16x16 character.
steps.limit: Export PNG or GIF. Keep sprites between 8x8 and 256x256.

steps.title: Animate it
steps.desc: Sprite Animator. Add a few frames and set the timing.
steps.limit: Upload a PNG (or GIF) spritesheet. Frames up to 512x512.

steps.title: Share the card
steps.desc: Trading Card Designer. Drop in your art and export a PNG.
steps.limit: Upload PNG, JPG or WebP art. Export PNG or 300 DPI print PNG.

intentPaths.title: Make a game
intentPaths.blurb: Draw a hero, build a level, then share a playable game.

steps.title: Make the hero
steps.desc: Pixel Studio. Draw one character sprite for your game.
steps.limit: Export PNG. Sprites between 8x8 and 256x256 load best.

steps.title: Build the world
steps.desc: World Builder. Lay out a small level with platforms.
steps.limit: Import a PNG tileset. Export JSON, Godot data or PNG.

steps.title: Ship and share it
steps.desc: Arcade Game Maker. Load your art and level, then share a playable link.
steps.limit: Sprites PNG up to 512x512 (2.8 MB). Backgrounds JPG or PNG up to 800x600 (3.5 MB).

intentPaths.title: Make music and sound
intentPaths.blurb: Start a loop, add a sound effect, then hear it in a game.

steps.title: Make a loop
steps.desc: Audio Studio. Use Music mode for a short backing loop.
steps.limit: Export WAV, ready for a game.

steps.title: Add a sound effect
steps.desc: Audio Studio. Switch to SFX and make a jump or coin sound.
steps.limit: Export WAV (or load a MIDI file to start).

steps.title: Put it in a game
steps.desc: Arcade Game Maker. Load your sounds and share the build.
steps.limit: Upload MP3 or WAV sound files.

intentPaths.title: Get unstuck
intentPaths.blurb: Find the fix, copy working code, then plan your next move.

steps.title: Find the bug
steps.desc: Error Guide. Look up the error in plain language.

steps.title: Grab a working snippet
steps.desc: Code Snippet Generator. Copy a starter for the pattern you need.

steps.title: Plan the fix
steps.desc: Game Planner. Turn the fix into quests and export the plan.

intentNote: Stick to these sizes and your art loads first time. Anything bigger is rejected or shrunk by the destination tool, so it is quicker to resize before you upload.

pixel-studio.limits: Export PNG or GIF. Canvas 8x8 to 256x256.
pixel-studio.touchNote: On a tablet, use the Eraser button and the -/+ zoom buttons. Right-click erase and wheel zoom need a mouse.
pixel-studio.cardDesc: Unified pixel art studio - Simple 8x8-32x32 for kids, plus character templates (humanoid/creature/chibi/top-down), layers, frames, onion skin, spritesheet & GIF export. One studio, no installs.

sprite-animator.limits: Upload a PNG or GIF sheet. Frame size up to 512x512.
sprite-animator.cardDesc: Got a spritesheet already? Upload it, choose frames, set the timing and export a pack. Drawing a character from scratch? Pixel Studio includes Animate, so you can draw and animate in one place.

bitmap-font-maker.cardDesc: Draw pixel fonts character by character, preview text and export spritesheets, atlases or BMFont XML.

trading-card-designer.limits: Upload PNG, JPG or WebP art. Export PNG or 300 DPI print PNG.
trading-card-designer.cardDesc: Create character cards with templates, rarities, stats, uploaded art and PNG export.

minecraft-skin-editor.touchNote: On a tablet, tap to paint and use the zoom bar. Precise 64x64 skin edits are easier with a mouse or stylus.
minecraft-skin-editor.cardDesc: Paint a Minecraft skin pixel by pixel, preview it on a spinning 3D player and export a PNG. Free, no install, no account.

colour-palette.cardDesc: Build a colour palette for your game, copy the hex codes and export a swatch to use in Pixel Studio or your project.

sound-studio.limits: Export WAV. Import MIDI or a project JSON.
sound-studio.cardDesc: One studio, three modes: Music for songs and loops, Drums for a quick beat, SFX for single game sounds. Export WAV or send to Game Maker.

buildlab.touchNote: On a tablet, use the Build/Orbit touch toggle and the zoom buttons. Precise placement is easier with a mouse.
buildlab.cardDesc: Make Roblox-style 3D block models with shapes, paint, transforms, touch support and OBJ / GLTF / RBXM export.

level-designer.limits: Import a PNG tileset. Export JSON, Godot data or PNG.
level-designer.touchNote: On a tablet, tap to place tiles and use the -/+ zoom buttons. Drag-painting is smoother with a mouse.
level-designer.cardDesc: Build levels, generate maps, import tilesets, test play spaces and export game-ready world data.

tabletop-studio.limits: Boards up to 20 x 15 tiles. Saves in this browser and exports a PNG.
tabletop-studio.cardDesc: Paint a board on squares or hexes, drop in meeples and cards, roll d4 to d20 dice and switch to Play mode. Saves on this device.

particle-designer.cardDesc: Design fire, smoke, sparks, magic and other VFX with curves, gradients and engine-friendly exports.

gdd-builder.cardDesc: Brainstorm ideas, plan core mechanics, write a full GDD and export your game plan from one studio.

story-editor.cardDesc: Create branching dialogue, character nodes, choices, endings, visual story links and JSON exports.

arcade-game-maker.limits: PNG sprites up to 512x512 (2.8 MB). JPG or PNG backgrounds up to 800x600 (3.5 MB). MP3 or WAV audio.
arcade-game-maker.touchNote: On a tablet, use the Erase button and tap to paint. Fine tile painting is easier with a mouse or stylus.
arcade-game-maker.note: Finishing tool - uses your Pixel Studio art, World Builder levels and Audio Studio sound.
arcade-game-maker.cardDesc: Prototype browser games from templates, tune physics, import art/audio/levels and share a playable build.

code-snippet-generator.cardDesc: Create starter snippets for common game-dev patterns and copy them into your project.

error-guide.cardDesc: Look up common beginner bugs and get plain-language fixes.

quest-board.cardDesc: Turn game tasks, projects, bugs and polish passes into quests with progression, planning views and local saves.

icon-generator.cardDesc: Generate Quest Board-style pixel icons and download ready-sized PNGs.

rocket-builder.cardDesc: Build a 3D rocket from nosecone to engine bells, then export it for your game or launch it right here.

robot-builder.cardDesc: Design a 3D robot from head to legs, power it up and export it as a game-ready model.

castle-builder.cardDesc: Raise a 3D medieval castle: walls, towers, gates, keeps, moats and banners, then export the build.

space-station-builder.cardDesc: Assemble a 3D space station from modules, solar panels and docking ports, then export it.

fairy-tale-builder.cardDesc: Design a 3D fairy tale cottage with roof, windows, doors and garden, then export it.

pirate-ship-builder.cardDesc: Build a 3D pirate ship: pick the hull, sails and cannons, then sail it and export the model.

steampunk-airship-builder.cardDesc: Design a steampunk airship with balloon, hull, propellers and fins, then fly it and export it.

race-car-builder.cardDesc: Build a 3D race car: body, engine, wheels, aero parts and livery, then race it and export it.

submarine-builder.cardDesc: Design a 3D submarine: hull, conning tower, propeller, fins and sonar, then dive and export it.

pirate-cannon-builder.cardDesc: Build and fire a pirate cannon game: set the ship, cannon power and targets, then export the model.

phone-stand-builder.cardDesc: Design a 3D printable phone stand: style, size, angle and grip, then export an STL to print.
